spec.sequence: Coming from the north-west, the hut domes and the landing lanterns show first; the road passes between the huts to the ford. The well roof shows across the water.
spec.wayfinding: Follow the road through the landing to the ford; the poler's hut stands on the bank above it.

spec.sequence: Coming down the road from the south-east, the station house roof and its smoke show first, then the well at the junction and the lean-to by the fire; the ford and the huts beyond open up at the junction.
spec.wayfinding: The road runs past the yard wall to the well junction; the station house path leaves the street there.

spec.value: A mixed village at the road's water point: an Imperial well on the south bench, an Argonian landing on the north bank across the ford. The landing is older than the station.
Two communities share it because neither can hold the other's half.
The well is Imperial-built and failing. The landing will not help to repair it in stone.
A perennial spring beside a boat channel, where the road fords the water.
Would become one community or two villages within a generation.

value.loreSource: type recipe road-station-village (a keeper and travellers); record occupants D1 family (few), D2 travellers (few); roster npcs.json well-keeper and poler
value.why: Two named keepers and one landing family live here; travellers come and go. Six buildings stand, three in the well-station and three in the landing; the dry ground holds no seventh. Beside them stand the well, the lean-to, the ferry raft and the dry-stone walls that hold the two station pads.
